summary.work_completed: Fixed all 6 root causes for Bug #88 — all interactive elements non-functional. Wired event handlers across 12 production files: CSS pointer-events fix, Viewport pointer handler wiring, useBrickPlacement engine invocation, BrickPalette onClick handlers, Toolbar onClick handlers, useKeyboardShortcuts global mount, useUndoRedo store wiring, and window.__legoApp store exposure.
key_findings: Root cause #1: Viewport.tsx did not spread useBrickPlacement pointer handlers onto R3F Canvas group
Root cause #2: BrickPalette.tsx rendered options but had no onClick handlers connected to uiStore
Root cause #3: useBrickPlacement.ts returned no-op stubs instead of invoking placementEngine
Root cause #4: Toolbar.tsx rendered buttons but onClick handlers were missing/no-op
Root cause #5: useKeyboardShortcuts was not mounted in App.tsx and only handled Escape
Root cause #6: CSS pointer-events: none on canvas container blocked all interactions

human_review_required.reason: Current implementation uses sequential grid positions; full raycasting-based placement may need refinement
data-testid and aria-label attributes added to components; verify they match E2E test expectations
